summary.text: Clay Yarborough represents District 4 in the Florida Senate, to which Yarborough was elected in 2022, and served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2016 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Yarborough served on the Jacksonville City Council from 2007 to 2015, as council president in 2014-2015.
The Senate lists Yarborough's occupation as business development and lists the University of North Florida under education. Yarborough was born in Mobile, Alabama, and moved to Florida in 1985.
